desc: convert an Atari Neochrome .neo into a PPM image
r: neotoppm - convert an Atari Neochrome .neo into a PPM image

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

neotoppm reads an Atari Neochrome .neo file as input and produces a PPM image as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for neotoppm, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
